title: Life Changing Astro — Claim-Safety Ledger & Certificate Decoder (2026)
description: A consultation is an advisory service, not a medical, legal or financial outcome. Here is what the store's own pages actually say about certificates, energisation and pricing — and what Durza cannot verify.

Buyers who want to know exactly which rudraksha SKUs list an X-ray or lab certificate before paying.
skipIf: Anyone seeking a guaranteed result in health, litigation, employment, relationships or finance — no such outcome is verified or promised here.
People who need clinical care, therapy, legal advice or financial planning. Use qualified professionals for those decisions.

content_blocks.heading: What does Life Changing Astro actually verify, and can a consultation change an outcome?
content_blocks.body: Its own site says 'Selected Rudraksha comes with an X-ray certificate' and many bead listings carry a 'Lab Certified · Authentic' badge; several product titles say the X-ray certificate is optional. That contradicts older Durza copy claiming a certificate ships with every mala. The rudraksha consultation page offered a session at ₹99. No outcome claim was verified, and Durza makes none: astrology is advisory and devotional, not a clinical, legal or financial guarantee. Codes RUDRA20, ASTRO15 and GEM10 were not confirmed on official pages on 26 Nov 2026.

items.title: Claim-safety box: read the verbatim claim, then the limit
items.body: CLAIM 1 — 'Selected Rudraksha comes with an X-ray certificate' (store homepage). Limit: 'selected' is not 'every'; several product titles say 'Optional X-Ray Certificate', so ask which variant you are buying. CLAIM 2 — 'Every product is energized (Abhimantrit) through traditional pooja vidhi' (store homepage). Limit: a ritual statement of faith; Durza cannot observe or verify it. CLAIM 3 — consultation gives 'clarity, protection and direction' (consultation page). Limit: subjective guidance, not a measurable result. CLAIM 4 — older Durza copy: 'third-party lab certificates shipped with every mala'. Limit: contradicted by the store's own wording; not carried forward. We found no verified evidence that any product changes health, legal, relationship or financial outcomes.

items.title: Certificate decoder: what the badge does and does not tell you
items.body: 'Lab Certified · Authentic' is a seller badge on the catalogue, not a named laboratory or a numbered report in the text we could read. 'Optional X-Ray Certificate' means the certificate may be a paid or selectable variant. 'AIGS Certified' appears on specific Ganesh Mukhi, Garbh Gauri and Gauri Shankar listings. 'X-ray certificate' usually refers to imaging of the bead's internal locules to support a mukhi count — it supports an identity claim, not a spiritual or medical effect. Ask the seller for the issuing lab, report number and a photograph of the exact bead before paying.

items.title: Consultation terms you should read before paying
items.body: The consultation page offered a session at ₹99 and described a form requiring full name, email, phone, date, time and place of birth, plus a purpose, followed by payment and contact within one to two business days via a G-Meet session. It says personal details remain confidential. The site's terms and conditions were last updated 1 Feb 2025 and are governed by the laws of Rajasthan with disputes in Jaipur. Those are verifiable page facts; they are not a satisfaction guarantee.

items.title: Why no outcome claim belongs in a buying guide
items.body: ASCI's self-regulation code exists to keep advertising truthful and not misleading. Astrology, numerology and vastu claims are matters of belief, not independently demonstrated cause and effect. Durza will not frame a purchase as a way to cure illness, win a case, secure a job or guarantee a relationship result. If a seller does, treat that as a reason to pause, not a reason to spend more.

items.body: Decide whether you want guidance or a product. A ₹99 consultation is a separate service from a bead purchase; neither implies the other.
If buying a bead, screenshot the exact product title, variant and price. 'Optional certificate' variants are easy to confuse with certified ones.
Ask customer care for the issuing lab, report number and a photo of the exact bead before paying for a high-value mukhi.
Check the refund and exchange policy on the site before purchase; the terms page only says refunds follow a separate policy.
Do not share birth details or pay for a consultation if you are being told a specific misfortune will occur unless you spend more.
Keep the session for reflection. For health, legal, financial or mental-health decisions, use a qualified professional.

items.label: The store says selected rudraksha comes with an X-ray certificate.
items.value: The homepage wording is 'Selected Rudraksha comes with an X-ray certificate'. Several consultation-page product titles say the X-ray certificate is optional. Durza did not inspect a physical certificate.

items.label: The consultation page quoted ₹99.
items.value: The page described a one-on-one online rudraksha consultation at ₹99, with a form collecting birth details and a G-Meet follow-up within one to two business days.

items.label: The site names a legal entity and GSTIN.
items.value: The footer identifies MASTER VASTU PRIVATE LIMITED with GST No 08AAQCM7563B1Z6 and a Jaipur address. That is a business-identity fact, not an endorsement of efficacy.

items.label: Terms are governed by Rajasthan law.
items.value: The terms page, last updated 1 Feb 2025, states governing law of the State of Rajasthan and exclusive jurisdiction of courts in Jaipur. It also limits liability and says refunds follow a separate policy.

items.label: Older Durza certificate and coupon claims failed verification.
items.value: An earlier entry said certificates ship with every mala and listed RUDRA20, ASTRO15 and GEM10. The store's own wording contradicts 'every', and no code term was readable on official pages on 26 Nov 2026.

items.label: ASCI publishes a code for advertising self-regulation.
items.value: The Advertising Standards Council of India's code page provides the framework for truthful and non-misleading advertising. We found no published ASCI ruling specific to this seller on 26 Nov 2026 — that is a verification gap, not a clean bill.

content_blocks.text: We checked Life Changing Astro's homepage, consultation page and terms, and the ASCI code page, on 26 Nov 2026. Product descriptions, prices and the ₹99 consultation fee are store-published snapshots. We did not inspect any certificate, book a consultation or buy a product, and we found no evidence that any item or session produces a specific life outcome. Codes from an older Durza entry were not verified. Where the store's wording ('selected', 'optional') conflicts with older copy ('every'), we follow the store's wording. Astrology is treated here as advisory and devotional; Durza promises no result. Durza earns a commission on qualifying purchases through tracked links at no extra cost to you.

items: 'Selected' and 'optional' certificate wording is not the same as a certificate with every mala — confirm your exact variant.
'Lab Certified' is a store badge; ask for the lab name, report number and a bead-matching photo before paying for a high-value item.
An X-ray certificate can support a mukhi-count identity claim; it says nothing about spiritual or medical efficacy.
No astrology service can be represented as a substitute for medical, psychological, legal or financial advice.
Be wary of any sales conversation that ties a specific misfortune to a larger purchase.
ASCI's code is a self-regulatory framework; we found no seller-specific ruling, and none is implied here.

items.q: Will a rudraksha or consultation fix my health, career or relationship problem?
items.a: Durza makes no such claim and found no verified evidence for one. Treat a consultation as reflective or devotional guidance. For health, legal, financial or mental-health decisions, use a qualified professional.

items.q: Does every mala come with a lab certificate?
items.a: The store's own homepage says 'Selected Rudraksha comes with an X-ray certificate', and several product titles say 'Optional X-Ray Certificate'. Older Durza copy claiming a certificate with every mala was wrong and has been corrected.

items.q: What does 'Lab Certified · Authentic' mean here?
items.a: It is a seller badge on the catalogue. In the text we could read, no issuing laboratory or report number was shown. Ask customer care for both before buying a high-value bead.
The consultation page we checked on 26 Nov 2026 quoted ₹99 for a one-on-one online session. Prices can change; the page is authoritative.

items.q: Do RUDRA20, ASTRO15 or GEM10 work?
items.a: Unverified. Those codes appeared in an older Durza entry but were not found on any official Life Changing Astro page on 26 Nov 2026. Do not assume a discount.

items.q: Did Durza verify the spiritual claims?
items.a: No. We reported them as the seller's claims, and explicitly declined to verify or promise any outcome. We did not inspect a certificate, book a session or buy a product.
